svg.title: Scriptw versus V8: verified fresh-Realm execution

cc:Work.dc:title: Scriptw versus V8: verified fresh-Realm execution
cc:Work.dc:description: Fresh Store/Realm execution, all 17 checked workloads. Measured 2026-10-25 01:50 UTC; Scriptw ab97459e54f9e0cd3ed983d098c46ccacac8fec6; baseline 4ad59d1ebbc64c9e3384aee9cefd19e3c8b8e92d with its archived patch. Lower is better. Time uses a logarithmic axis and paired current-round V8 samples. Memory compares Scriptw sampled process RSS using a linear axis; it includes runtime/setup and retained warmup effects, not live JavaScript bytes or a whole-child peak. Both panels use medians of 14 observations per product. Existing-Realm calls are a separate cohort. Shared-host observations do not establish statistical significance or V8 parity. Source report SHA-256: 37c6d7eca2c7a22377bd1da90755d65b631786a4768e3c1a9a0408462083ab12.
